notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 ENCORE (No.10, front, full body, facing the lens): the stare and the cue. Front view, never mirrored (no west strip). Registration = Stand Front: body centre x 64, soles on row 102. contact = the outer (screen-right) sole pixel (85,102) of the planted LEFT boot, which keeps the Idle Front pixels and is pixel-identical on all five frames (soleRun = its row-102 run [x0,102,x1,102], plantSole = its centre); the RIGHT sole (screen-left) rests on the ball. ball = the 12 px ball guide (50,98) (never drawn; ballUnder = draw the ball BEFORE the sprite: it sits a ball-width nearer the lens, the sole (49,92) on its crown). eyeL / eyeR = screen-left / screen-right eye, pupilL / pupilR = the one lit pupil pixel each (eyeGlow and the stage-light cross glints sit here; the mop shadow over the eyes is code); head = skull centre; chest = sternum; num = chest "10" box. EN2/EN3/EN3b: hand = the open palm centre, tip1-tip4 = fingertips (screen-left to right), thumb, wrist, elbow (the cue arm is his RIGHT arm, screen-left). Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). bbox / com measured on the art. Shot 3: EN1 0.00, EN1b 0.20, EN1 0.40, EN1b 0.60 (x2.8); 2b: EN1 at 2.20 (fluoro boots + eyes, x1.6); 9c: EN1 1.20, EN2 1.40, EN3 1.60, EN3b 1.90, EN3 2.00, EN3b 2.10, freeze EN3b from 2.20 (x2.2). EN1 and EN3 are Chorus sources (solid two-value silhouettes). Studio: Sochetra / Encore / Front, layer Art (Side/Back blank).
